paragraphs: Beam Global builds equipment for charging electric vehicles and for keeping power available where the grid is not. Public agencies can buy through a Sourcewell contract covering state and local government, higher education and the military across North America.

The flagship EV ARC generates and stores all of its own electricity rather than drawing from a utility connection. It is sized for a standard parking space, so vehicles park on the unit and no spaces are given up. Because it stands apart from the grid, the unit keeps charging through blackouts, and an optional panel can feed electricity to first responders and medical workers. A second product applies the same idea to bicycles, charging up to twelve eBikes on a transportable platform.

Beam Global says it was founded in 2006. The company is publicly traded on Nasdaq under the ticker BEEM. It is headquartered in San Diego with operations in Chicago, Europe and the Middle East, and says it employs combat veterans and individuals with disabilities.

quote.text: The patented EV ARC™ is the only 100% renewable, transportable, off-grid EV charging option on the market.
